bites.title: Check your work like a pro
bites.body: Every working artist has a checking routine. Here's a toolkit for yours.

bites.title: Reference images
bites.body: Pick the Reference Images tool from the toolbox and paste or open a reference. It floats over the canvas, never prints, and saves with the file.

bites.title: A second view
bites.body: Window > New View, then Window > Tile. Keep one view small: a thumbnail tells the truth about composition.

bites.title: Grid off
bites.body: And off again. Check, then hide.

bites.title: Painting assistants
bites.body: The Assistant Tool places perspective guides, ellipses and rulers that your brush can snap to. Pick it from the toolbox.

bites.title: Snap on and off
bites.body: {key:toggle_assistant|Ctrl+Shift+L} toggles snapping to assistants. Perfect ellipses on demand.

bites.title: 21 cleared
bites.body: Reference, thumbnail view, grid, assistants. Plus the mirror from lesson 02. Make it a routine.
